summary.name: MDViewer
summary.one_liner: A free, open-source native Markdown viewer for macOS with live reload, Quick Look previews, Mermaid diagrams, math rendering, and optional AI summaries.
use_cases: reviewing plans and reports written by coding agents
previewing markdown files in Finder without opening an app
reading long markdown documents with an AI summary
viewing Mermaid diagrams and math in markdown notes
keeping a rendered markdown view open beside an editor
summary.what_it_does: MDViewer is a macOS app that renders Markdown files as pages, including tables, task lists, alerts, footnotes, front matter, 200+ code languages, Mermaid diagrams and KaTeX math, aiming to match GitHub's rendering. It reloads the view on every file save while keeping the reader's position. Pressing Shift-Cmd-S produces a TL;DR of the document as a list or Mermaid diagram, with links to source sections; summaries can use a range of hosted providers with the user's own key, or local models via Ollama and LM Studio. Quick Look previews of .md files in Finder render the same content, including diagrams and math.
notable: Quick Look previews of Markdown files in Finder, with diagrams and math
One-key AI TL;DR with links back to source sections, using your own API key or a local model
Signed and notarized by Apple; 6 MB download; Apple silicon and Intel
Built with Tauri 2 (Rust) and Svelte; API keys stored in the macOS keychain
caveats: AI summaries need your own API key for a hosted provider or a locally run model
Summary of a document is sent to the chosen model only when you ask
